item.title: Why soaring prices aren't breaking America's diesel habit
item.description: The quickest and most affordable response to historically high diesel prices is also the simplest: use less of it. Why it matters: diesel is so entrenched...

item.title: New UFO documents released after mysterious "flying triangle" sighting

item.title: Wall Street prepares for AI's "day after"
item.description: America's largest banks are working to prevent AI worst-case scenarios and preparing for the "day after" a catastrophe, Axios has learned.

item.title: "People are tired of theater": The left sours on "performative" Trump impeachment
